propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue submits status as a field edit via issue.update(fields=...) instead of routing it through transition_issue_by_name, causing Jira to reject the status change silently
Cloud transport (JiraCloudTransport/acli.py) pops status from kwargs and routes it to transition_issue, but DC transport does not, creating asymmetric behaviour across deployment targets
Outbound status mapped via LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA reaches update_issue in the allowlisted fields dict but bypasses the transition resolution that bug 7f93 implemented for inbound paths
Status is not an editable field in Jira REST API and can only be changed via workflow transitions; submitting it through issue.update(fields={...}) leaves the issue in its current state
